subject: Purchase order validation & vendor enrollment — action plan
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@novanet.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novanet AP <ap@novanet.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor enrollment + PO validation requirements

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Procurement needs Redwood set up as a vendor in our AP system before we can issue a standing PO. To move forward we need: 

- Completed AP onboarding form (attached checklist would help)
- Tax documentation for US payments (W-9) and confirmations for EU VAT handling
- Sample invoice showing invoice number format, remit-to details, and required PO fields (we consume an XML template)
- Bank remit instructions (EFT/ACH) and beneficiary name exactly as on bank record

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a machine-readable sample PO (XML) with the tag names you expect for PO number, line-level pricing, and SKU/model? Our AP team validates incoming PO XML against the vendor profile.

If it's easier, put me on a 20-min call with your finance ops and we can walk through field mapping. We're aiming to create the vendor record and issue the initial quarterly PO by Dec 15.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Ruiz
Vendor Onboarding Lead — Novanet

Attachment(s): vendor-enrollment-template.xlsx (stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novanet.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment + PO validation requirements

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Shared next steps below and attached the docs you asked for.

Short plan (we can jump on a call if helpful):
1) I attached our AP_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf and Redwood_W9_and_VAT.pdf — those cover tax and legal details.
2) Attached sample-po-xml.xml: that mirrors the PO tags our billing engine maps to (PO number -> <poNumber>, lines -> <lineItems> with <sku>, <qty>, <unitPrice>).
3) Laura will confirm the exact remit name on file and the bank instructions we provide in the vendor profile.
4) Karthik will follow up on how we populate multi-tax (VAT) fields for EU customers when the PO includes tax-exempt flags.

Questions for your AP team (so we can validate mapping before you create the vendor):
- Which field do you use as the canonical PO identifier for matching? (poNumber vs. referenceId)
- Do you require line-level commodity codes or is SKU sufficient?
- Any custom tags we should include in the sample XML to avoid rejection?

Suggested 20-min sync: Thu Dec 2, 09:00 PST. Let me know if that works.

Thanks,
Vivek
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: AP_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf, Redwood_W9_and_VAT.pdf, sample-po-xml.xml

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novanet.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment + PO validation requirements

Hi Elena — quick clarifications from finance ops: 

- Remit name: "Redwood Inference, Inc." (exact legal entity). Use that as the beneficiary.
- Bank: ACH/EFT preferred. We'll include bank routing + account details in the vendor profile after ID verification.
- Invoice format: we can accept your XML sample as long as you send one invoice per payload (no batched invoice file). We will populate our AP system to accept <invoiceNumber>, <poNumber>, <invoiceDate>, and tax lines.
- VAT handling: if a PO has a VAT registration ID field populated, our system will not add VAT. If blank, our invoices must include VAT by default for EU destinations.

I attached a short checklist to show the minimum invoice fields we require. Also: please confirm whether Novanet requires a specific remit_to address field value in the XML (street vs. free-form). If you supply a sample invoice with the same XML tags as the sample PO, Karthik and I will validate against our invoice parser.

We can do the sync at Thu Dec 2, 09:00 PST — Vivek, sending calendar invite now.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): invoice-field-minimums.txt

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@novanet.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novanet AP <ap@novanet.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment + PO validation requirements

Thanks — that all looks good.

Quick updates following our sync: 
- Novanet will create vendor record once we receive the completed AP onboarding form + W-9.
- AP will accept your sample-po-xml.xml; canonical identifier is <poNumber>. They do not require commodity codes for Redwood services.
- Planned PO issuance: initial one-time PO (PO# 2027-9001) to be sent Dec 15; standing quarterly PO to follow in Jan.

A couple of action items for you: 
- Please send completed AP_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf with a scanned signature (PDF) by end of day Mon Dec 6.
- Confirm bank remit name exactly as it will appear on incoming EFTs (you wrote Redwood Inference, Inc. which is correct; we'll match that).

If everything is in the vendor record we should be able to push the first PO without needing additional approvals.

Best,
Elena
Vendor Onboarding Lead — Novanet
